title: follower: concurrent KeyPackage claims intermittently fail
description: follower_key_material.rs concurrent_claims_fall_back_to_the_last_resort_only_when_one_time_ones_are_gone failed in the .6.71 land run (2026-10-18): 3 of 12 concurrent serve_key_material calls returned Err (error text lost); it passed in the two earlier runs. Suspected SQLite write contention in the claim transaction, which would be a production bug under load. Under investigation; blocks landing .6.71 and F5 (.7.23), since every land run executes this test.
